$comment: Stands in for GET /api/v1/business-enquiries/{id}/business-suggestions. One candidate snapshot per matching run, keyed by enquiry. Excluded businesses are STORED with their reasons, not discarded — diagnostics are only possible if the exclusions survive the run. `factors` sum to `score`; the weights they are scored against live in matching-rules.json. Regenerated from the live business directory: 25 subscribed businesses, rule v3. Every businessId here exists in GET /api/v1/admin/business-enquiries/businesses/.
